canonical_definition:
Space of definitions. In the available definition, the construct is framed as processing conversational context and responding to dialogue-based inputs over long contexts. No competing definition or explicit disagreement appears in the papers represented here.

Space of measurement. Operationalization is limited in the papers here: it is linked to 1 measurement instrument and 1 behavioral indicator overall, but only the instrument is explicitly recorded as measuring it. InfiniteBench is the only linked measurement instrument, with evidence coming from a table entry for a "Dialogue" task in An Evolved Universal Transformer Memory. The only linked behavioral indicator is dialogue state tracking, but that link is recorded as related rather than measured_by, so the relationships do not provide a second direct measurement route.

Links. Beyond measurement, one paper reports that dialogue state tracking is related to dialogue understanding. In A Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Pipeline for Dialogue Understanding, the evidence connects dialogue state tracking to understanding user needs and executing appropriate system actions in task-oriented dialogues. No causal or correlational links are recorded, and no linked constructs are listed.
